I dropped two artifacts here: a lightweight spreadsheet MAP template and a starter Google Doc where we can draft owners, milestones, and eval criteria.

Attachments (stubs): MAP_Template_Redwood_v1.xlsx
Shared links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A_example_MAP_draft

Suggested next steps (30/60/90 style, but condensed for POC):

- Week 2: run integration validation + sample prompts (engineering).
- Week 3: evaluation run (latency/cost/quality) and exec summary prep.
- Target close: last business day of month (flexible).

Can you confirm who on your side should be the owner for engineering and procurement so we can add them to the MAP? I can carve out a 30-minute workshop to fill the doc with your team.

Thanks — I’ll also loop in Karthik with a slide template for the exec summary.

- Procurement: procurement@lighthouse.ai — they will need the standard security/compliance info and a short procurement timeline.
